Evaluate each named criterion independently
against its extracted value and the complete arguments of this SAME tool call.
Return one Boolean verdict and a concise evidence-based reason per check_id.
Do not combine criteria into a holistic score or add requirements.

Use the request and same-call arguments to resolve names, pronouns, abbreviations,
and intended authorship. Accept equivalent wording that communicates the required
meaning. A first-person document written for the requesting user can refer to
that user as I; do not demand repetition of a name when authorship is clear.
The request and criteria are not evidence that the action included an answer.
Missing, incomplete, ambiguous, contradictory, or negated REQUIRED meaning fails.
Do not confuse mentioning a forbidden claim in an explicit denial with making
that claim. Do not obtain missing content from another call or criterion.

Return only JSON: {"results": [{"check_id": "supplied ID", "passed": true,
"reason": "exact supporting text or missing requirement"}]}.
Include every supplied check_id exactly once and no additional IDs.

Cover populated and missing entitlement-name cases, the authoritative rendering source, fallback behavior, and the legacy source that must never be referenced.", "today": "2028-01-01", "tool": "create_doc", "arguments": {"title": "2028 Lifecycle QA Specification — Entitlement-Name Regression Coverage", "folder": "lifecycle-qa", "body": "Effective date: 2028-01-01

Scope
Regression coverage for the three active lifecycle templates:
- Renewal reminder
- Trial-expiry education (self-serve education variant only; not the Customer Success-routed “Trial expiry” variant)
- Integration summary (current active variant only; not the retired 2024 variant)

Authoritative rendering rule
- Render the entitlement name exclusively from `entitlement.display_name`.
- When that value is usable, render it verbatim in the intended entitlement-name position.
- Treat absent, null, empty-string, and whitespace-only-after-trimming values as missing.
- For missing values, render the exact approved fallback `your plan`; preserve the surrounding template’s capitalization, punctuation, and spacing.
- Do not infer an entitlement name from any other field.

Required QA matrix
1. Populated: `entitlement.display_name = "Pro"` → “Pro” appears in the intended position.
2. Changed-value precedence: legacy field contains `旧 Plan`; `entitlement.display_name = "Pro"` → only “Pro” appears.
3. Absent: `entitlement.display_name` is absent → exact fallback `your plan`.
4. Null: `entitlement.display_name = null` → exact fallback `your plan`.
5. Empty: `entitlement.display_name = ""` → exact fallback `your plan`.
6. ASCII whitespace: value is whitespace-only → exact fallback `your plan`.
7. Nonbreaking/Unicode whitespace: value is whitespace-only after trimming → exact fallback `your plan`.

Apply every case to all three in-scope active templates. For each preview, record immutable template ID, current release/version, audience, fixture payload, rendered subject/preheader/body or link label, and pass/fail result. A populated case must not pass merely because the fallback appears; a missing case must not produce a blank phrase.

Forbidden legacy source
`workspace.plan_name` must never be referenced or used by any active template path, including body copy, subject lines, preheaders, Liquid conditionals, defaults, fallbacks, links, or button labels. It must not be used as a comparison baseline or fallback. The changed-value and transition cases must prove that a stale or conflicting legacy value cannot affect output.

Release gate
PASS only when every in-scope active template passes all seven cases and a source inspection confirms zero `workspace.plan_name` references. Any blank, legacy-derived, or otherwise non-`your plan` missing-value render is a blocking failure; correct the active release and rerun the full matrix."}, "checks": [{"check_id": "riley_159_01", "path": "args", "criterion": "The title clearly identifies the document as a 2028 lifecycle entitlement-name regression or QA specification.
